login.title: Ca̱nɛl Partnɛr Lögin
login.welcome: Kä nhɔk yɛn ɛ! Sign in kɛ ɣöö biɛ kulɛ guic ɛ gɔaa.
login.heroTitle: Pith ko̱kädu min la nyin thuɔ̱ɔ̱k kɛ nɛy diaal tin nööŋkɛ
login.heroIntro: Portal kɛl min deri nɛy tin kɔakɛ ŋɔak gɔ̱r piny kä nɛy tin lät, tit credit kɛ kui̱ nɛɛni tin bëë kä ji̱ kä guur kɛ ni kɛ booking.

register.title: Reji̱thtɛr bo̱thɛ rɛy thɛkɔndi̱ni̱
register.text: Nyuɔ̱thni customer du kɛnɛ project in gör kɛn ɛ.

protect.title: Dupli̱kët ga̱ŋ
protect.text: Lead du bɛ te ni duŋdu kɛ guäth mi gaŋ ji, kɛ kui̱c ɛmɔ thiɛlɛ ram mi dɔ̱ŋ mi de ji moc kɛ customer mi cäät.

track.title: Track ɛni̱ i̱thtëj
track.text: Guic ta̱a̱ in bo̱o̱th kɛl kɛnɛ ciaaŋdɛ kɛɛliw, ɛ tuɔɔk ni̱ kä mëë ca kɔn röm kɛ nhiam ɛ wä kä mëë ca book.

handover.title: Krɛdit kä booking
handover.text: Mi ci customer book, bi lead thöp ram min lät duel kɛ ji ca gɔ̱r piny ɛ la source partner.

login.secure: Thi̱n-in mi̱ gaŋkɛ - ruaacni̱ ji̱ kɔaamni̱ku bi̱ kɛ te thi̱n ɛ la nɛy ti̱ /ka̱n ŋa̱c
login.builderLink: Gɔ̱ri rɔ piny kä thok duëël ta̱th

signup.title: Ca̱nɛl Partnɛr Reji̱thtɛciɔn
signup.intro: La̱tdɛ account du kɛ ɣöö biɛ tok kɛ gɔ̱a̱r piny kɛnɛ yuɔ̱p nɛɛni tin bi wä nhiam.
signup.partnerName: Ciöt raam min lät kɛɛl kɛ Channel *
